title: mcp: prompts/list projects a skill whose bound tools the connection does not serve, and a host has no declared seam to withhold one
body:
repo:cloud#4 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: finding from the cloud lane (cloud#4337, PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4419). Cloud now filters through a proxy over the `mcp` service; this card is the framework seam that replaces the proxy.

## What
On a `data:read` token, `/api/v1/mcp` `prompts/list` listed `metadata_authoring` (and 8 more in-app skills), which name 18 tools the connection does not list — measured red on the hosted rig (cloud e2e `mcp-served-guidance-4337`, item 1). `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts:156` (`listSkillPrompts`) and `mcp-server-runtime.ts:2488` (`registerSkillPrompts`) project every skill row with instructions; a host has no seam to keep a skill off the prompt surface.

## Expected
`prompts/list` / `prompts/get` project a skill only when the connection serves the tools it binds (`SkillSchema.tools` vs the request's served tool list), and/or a declared host seam to withhold skills per request. Cloud then drops its proxy after the next pin move. Pin test: a data-only connection lists no skill naming an unserved tool.

Seam: spec:SkillSchema.tools → runtime:packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts listSkillPrompts. Not in batch #32434-#32440/#32442/#32443. Dedupe words: skill prompt projection, prompts/list unserved tools, listSkills host filter, skill tools served. Related: cloud#4337.
